title: Sampled probe choreographer and on-call handoff scorecard
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: Reduce noisy probes and pager fatigue while improving first-responder context during handoffs by sampling probes intelligently and producing a compact handoff scorecard. This PR implements a sampled probe choreographer that schedules a small, representative set of lightweight probes per on-call window, tracks probe provenance, and emits a one-line handoff scorecard summarizing signal health and probe coverage. Changes include: 1) a new choreographer component (choreographer/sampled_scheduler.py) that picks probes deterministically using a weighted reservoir sampler tied to on-call rotation ids; 2) probe metadata propagation to the incident snapshot (snapshot/attachments.md -> snapshot metadata additions) so responders can see sample reason and TTL; 3) a handoff scorecard generator (handoff/scorecard.py) that produces a compact human-friendly summary and machine-readable tags for rollups; 4) a lightweight CLI to preview scheduled probes for the upcoming shift (bin/preview-probes) and a console widget to surface the scorecard in the on-call dashboard. Safety/perf: the choreographer enforces a configurable probe budget per rotation (default 8 probes per 6h window), backoff for noisy endpoints (exponential backoff on repeated failures), and samples across metadata dimensions (region, service, metric-family) to preserve coverage. Tests and CI: unit tests for sampler, deterministic-seeding tests, e2e simulated on-call run that verifies scorecard appears in handoff payloads. Rollout plan: feature gated behind incident_features.sampled_probes; gradual enablement by rotation -> team -> org with metrics monitored (probe hit rate, responder opens, pager volume). Checklist: - [x] design doc linked: https://linear.app/ENG/notes/sampled-probe-choreographer - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] add feature flag - [x] update docs and console widget - [x] added metrics/traces for rollout. Commits summary: "init sampled choreographer and basic scheduler"; "propagate probe metadata to snapshots"; "handoff scorecard formatting and tags"; "cli preview and console widget wiring"; "tests and docs". Changed files (high level): choreographer/sampled_scheduler.py, handoff/scorecard.py, snapshot/metadata_adapter.py, bin/preview-probes, web/ui/widgets/handoff_scorecard.vue, tests/test_sampler.py, docs/oncall/sampled-probes.md. Small illustrative snippet included in scheduler (single-line): "selection = reservoir.sample(candidates, budget, seed=rotation_id_hash)". Review convo summary: Ben Carter: "Can we ensure sampling is stable across rotation reassignments? If rotation id changes we'll lose continuity." Author reply: "Yes — scheduler seeds with rotation_id_hash derived from rotation uid and start timestamp; added deterministic-seeding tests (see test_sampler.py)." Maya Patel (requested changes): "Need clearer observability: add histogram for probe latency and a tag for sample_reason in traces." Author reply: "Added histograms and propagated sample_reason tag into trace spans; updated trace schema doc." Liam O'Connor: "Approve with minor nit on CLI help wording." Author reply: "Addressed nit and re-ran CI." CI: pipeline passed (unit+lint+integration); one flaky e2e rerun was required and passed on rerun. Merge outcome: merged by squash on 2026-02-25 (merge method: squash, merge commit message: "Sampled probe choreographer + handoff scorecard (ENG-3112)"). Release notes: "Added experimental sampled probe scheduling to reduce pager noise and a compact handoff scorecard that surfaces probe coverage and signal health. Feature gated and off by default." Additional notes: Monitoring dashboards created under SLO/Oncall (probe_budget_utilization, handoff_score_distribution). Follow-ups: instrument probe deduplication across overlapping rotations (ENG-3120), expand sampling policy to use anomaly-weighted scoring (SRE-47).
